'If you've played an instant card THIS CHAIN LINK, this gets +1{p}.'

THE WINDOW IS A CHAIN LINK, not a turn: a turn holds several links and a per-turn record would keep the bonus alive for the rest of the combat. combat.link_plays is the per-link record (CR 7.0.3e: a layer is played on the ACTIVE chain link).

Go again is printed here and UNCONDITIONAL -- the gate is on the +1{p} only -- so it is deliberately not declared conditional; doing so would take away a keyword the card has.
